text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the day of the Takarazuka Kinen, Winning Ticket enthusiastically tells me that she'll make it an exciting race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just before it begins, she tells Biwa Hayahide how she hopes to run a great race that will wow the audience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though Hayahide senses something off about those words, she also promises to give it her all. And with that, they prepare to face off.
